detail.text: WARNING: DISTANT SPREAD OF TOXIN EFFECT — effects may spread from the injection area to produce botulinum toxin effects; swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening with reports of death

citations.quote: ## WARNING: DISTANT SPREAD OF TOXIN EFFECT

The effects of all botulinum toxin products, including LETYBO, may spread from the area of injection to produce symptoms consistent with botulinum toxin effects. These symptoms have been reported hours to weeks after injection. Swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have been reports of death.
